# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 051

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1250–1274, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. Changed: 25 English definitions, including 2 source examples. Refreshed source fingerprints for these 25 senses in the locale status files.  
Progress: 1,275/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (14.43%); 7,562 remain.
